source_blocks.text:
Juniper Freight annual disclosures, USD millions. FY2021 runs from October 1, 2020 through September 30, 2021; FY2020 runs from October 1, 2019 through September 30, 2020. Columns: FY2021 FY2020.
East segment revenue 73 68
Consolidated revenue 120 110
Consolidated adjusted operating profit 11 10

Note 2. Effective October 1, 2020, the East segment reporting boundary changed. The FY2020 East segment revenue amount of USD 68 million has been retrospectively recast for comparison with FY2021. FY2021 is reported directly on the new boundary and is not a retrospectively recast period. The boundary change did not affect consolidated financial statements for either FY2021 or FY2020. Consolidated adjusted operating profit is issuer-defined; see Note 9 for its adjustment definition and reconciliation.

revenue.definition: Revenue in USD for the explicitly identified consolidated or segment scope.

adjusted_operating_profit.definition: Issuer-defined adjusted operating profit; its name does not establish the adjustment items. A source reconciliation is needed.

assertions.text: FY2020 East segment revenue of USD 68 million has been retrospectively recast onto the new boundary.
FY2021 East segment revenue of USD 73 million is itself a retrospectively recast historical-period figure.
This boundary change did not affect the consolidated financial statements for FY2021 or FY2020.
The FY2021 consolidated adjusted operating profit measure excludes only lease costs and no other items.
